# mondoo_integration_domain (Resource)

Continuously scan endpoints to evaluate domain TLS, SSL, HTTP, and HTTPS security. Create it in a Mondoo organization (`org_id`), whose asset routing rules place the assets into spaces, or in a space (`space_id`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "mondoo" {
  space = "hungry-poet-123456"
}

# Set up the Domain integration
resource "mondoo_integration_domain" "domain_integration" {
  host  = "mondoo.com"
  https = true
  http  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Domain name or IP address.

### Optional

- `http` (Boolean) Enable HTTP port.
- `https` (Boolean) Enable HTTPS port.
- `org_id` (String) Mondoo organization identifier. Set this to create the integration in the organization. Conflicts with `space_id`.
- `space_id` (String) Mondoo space identifier. If neither `space_id` nor `org_id` is set, the provider space is used.

### Read-Only

- `mrn` (String) Integration identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using integration MRN.
terraform import mondoo_integration_domain.domain_integration "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
